name: AGC 742601 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 742601, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc742601-hubble
story: A little dwarf galaxy rich in hydrogen gas, first found by a radio survey. Hubble counted its red giant stars to measure how far away it lies.

claims.text: AGC 742601 is a SHIELD II target of Hubble program 13750, 'Fundamental Parameters of the SHIELD II Galaxies'
SHIELD galaxies are gas-rich dwarf galaxies
SHIELD galaxies were selected from the ALFALFA radio (HI) survey catalog
The Hubble imaging was used to measure distances from the tip of the red giant branch
A TRGB distance was measured for AGC 742601
